//: Project settings for the Foundry week-1 spike.
The hooks below run the *fast* checks after an edit -- lint and types on
the one file that changed. The full suite is not run here on purpose: a
hook that takes ten seconds on every keystroke-sized edit gets disabled,
and a disabled hook protects nothing. The full gauntlet lives in the
`spike-validate` skill and in CI, which are the places it belongs.
Permissions are an allowlist of the read-only and validation commands this
repo actually uses, so routine work does not prompt. Anything that writes
outside the repo, or touches the linted target repo, still prompts.
